pages.text: The $(item)Huge Wild Skyseed$() — a Large Wild Skyseed ringed between an $(item)Ender Pearl$() and $(item)Blaze Powder$(), packed in dirt and sand. End-game, like all huge seeds: both come from the $(item)Nether$(), so you want it, you farm for it.
The large seed between an ender pearl and blaze powder, packed in dirt and sand.

$(bold)The grand tour$()$(br)A $(bold)huge$() island of the local biome, with a deep, ore-veined body — and the space to host even the biggest buildings, should the roll bring one. Expensive, but the finest way to be surprised.
